transcript.text: Namaste, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm the studio's AI assistant. May I ask a few quick questions?
Yes, I'm Priya Kulkarni. We bought a 3BHK in Baner and want a full interior redesign with execution.
Lovely. About how big is it, and when would you need it complete?
About 1400 sq ft. We'd like to move in by end of January.
And are you the one deciding on the project?
Yes, my husband and I decide together, he's fine with me handling this.
I was going to ask that.
Pricing depends on the site, the materials you choose, and the scope. Your designer will walk you through it in detail at the consultation.
